nodes.summary: Add a proven-mlx-port optimization method for block weight streaming from inspectable safetensors, scoped to repeated-block models that exceed unified-memory budget. Validation gate: Block-count/key coverage, streamed-vs-eager parity on a tiny fixture, eviction/reload test, peak-memory measurement, and fallback eager path. Rollback: Disable streaming if outputs drift, block key coverage is incomplete, eviction reloads stale weights, or disk/page-fault overhead erases the memory benefit.
nodes.title: block weight streaming

nodes.summary: Add a proven-mlx-port optimization method for PyTorch-compatible grid_sample custom kernels, scoped to spatial/volume-warping ports with explicit parity and end-to-end benchmark gates. Validation gate: Coordinate order, align_corners, padding mode, interpolation, dtype, and layout parity against NumPy/Torch; unsupported-mode declaration; pure-MLX fallback; end-to-end benchmark. Rollback: Disable or hold if reflection/nearest/backward semantics are required, parity drifts, layout transposes dominate, or the model-level benchmark does not improve.
nodes.title: grid sample spatial kernel
